text:
- Jonah: Covering for Finn. Swapping desks with Kira.
- Finn: Out for the rest of the week.
- Nils: Wants east wing and garden studio kept clear for visitors.
- Dovworth warehouse pallet capacity: 5,325.
- Pia: Swapping desks with Wren. Out for the week. Thinks library annex too cold in afternoon.
- Wren: Swapping desks with Pia.
- Print room: Umbrella left there again. Afternoon stand-up moved here. Too cold. Slow lift. Repainting (evening noise). Mira, Hugo, and Rafe find it too cold. Ines wants it kept clear for visitors.
- Una: Swapping desks with Esme. Prefers loading bay.
- Esme: Swapping desks with Una. Prefers harbour room for reviews.
- Library annex: Lift slow. Repainting (morning noise). Hugo prefers it. Evening stand-up moved here. Morning stand-up moved to east wing. Pia thinks too cold in afternoon. Una thinks too cold in morning.
- Harbour room: Umbrella left there. Lift slow. Coffee machine working. No longer hosts afternoon stand-up. Repainting (evening noise). Esme prefers it for reviews.
- Loading bay: Lift slow. Umbrella left there. Coffee machine working. Una prefers it.
- Kira: Swapping desks with Vik and Jonah. Wants print room clear. User needs to send Kira afternoon meeting notes.
- Vik: Swapping desks with Kira. Needs evening notes.
- Suri: Swapping desks with Opal. Covering for Bram and Leon. Needs evening notes. Thinks garden studio too cold in evening.
- Mira: Prefers north office. Thinks print room too cold in afternoon.
- Hugo: Prefers library annex. Thinks print room too cold in evening.
- Ines: Prefers garden studio. Wants print room kept clear for visitors.
- Ada: Prefers north office. Needs morning notes. Swapping desks with Teo.
- Garden studio: Umbrella left there. Bram and Nils prefer it kept clear. Suri finds it too cold in evening.
- Bram: Out; Suri covering. Prefers garden studio.
- Leon: Needs evening notes.
- North office: Repainting. Mira, Opal, and Ada prefer it. Dell asked if free in morning.
- East wing: Coffee machine working. Hosts stand-ups. Greta and Ines prefer it. Morning stand-up moved here. Someone left an umbrella there again.
- Rafe: Swapping desks with Pia. Thinks print room too cold.
- Greta: Covering for Pia. Involved. Prefers east wing.
- Teo: Swapping desks with Ada.
- Dovley warehouse pallet capacity: 6,050.
- Harmore fleet fuel allowance: 4,575.
- Wynstead warehouse crate count: 7,750.
